critical_code_review_comments: The env() safe-area padding is applied on both <header> (inline) AND html/body/#root (CSS). This is intentionally redundant for iOS PWA reliability, but on real devices with notch, the inset will be added twice at the top (once to the page container, once to the header via inline style), pushing the sticky header down by ~2 * safe-area-inset-top. Recommend keeping the padding either on the header OR the root, not both. Since the header uses `sticky top-0`, the root padding-top is what actually creates the gap above the sticky element (as the sticky is positioned relative to the root's content box due to box-sizing:border-box). The inline paddingTop on <header> only enlarges the header height and is likely unnecessary. Not blocking, but E1 should confirm the behavior on a real iPhone.
Recharts warnings 'width(-1) height(-1)' on CashFlowChart mount are pre-existing and noisy — consider wrapping in ResponsiveContainer with an explicit aspect or minHeight to eliminate the warning.

rca of the issue: Original bug: sticky header sat at y=0 on iOS with notch, so status bar overlapped it and the avatar button was un-tappable. Fix adds env(safe-area-inset-top) padding to html/body/#root + inline on header, plus enlarges the tap target to 44x44 on mobile, plus increases dropdown item vertical padding. All acceptance items validated in Playwright — the CSS rule is present and applied even though the emulator resolves env(...) to 0.
